verdict_scope: R2 revises the focal P1342 contract after the independent R1 adversarial report. It does not seal or accept any implementation and does not authorize P1340 lifecycle/profile, NT01-NT06, terminal policy or general parity.

l0_assessment.reason: The ten frozen L0 owners already require real hook emission into a per-execution/per-attempt append-only ledger, local correlation identifiers, a shared cfg-only handle, and projection without fabrication. The fresh verifier challenge, append receipts and immutable raw pre-projection snapshot are test-only evidence mechanics that discriminate those existing obligations; they do not alter public API, default product behavior or pipeline phase.

revision_closure.B01: The binding document and DTO schemas are exact and closed; every hook has a pinned candidate-free symbol+branch anchor, and dead/cfg(test)-only lookalikes cannot satisfy live receipt coverage.
revision_closure.B02: The same carrier is mandatory on every wrapper/edge/inner/closure/body transition; Location and before/after snapshots come from continuous runtime observations, including replay exit.
revision_closure.B03: A verifier-supplied fresh challenge binds local identifiers, every append has a chained receipt, and the raw ledger is frozen and inspectable before projection; the chain is necessary but explicitly insufficient without source and runtime inspection.
revision_closure.B04: Normal, repeat and reverse executions use fresh challenges and reject fixed identifiers, fabricated snapshots and post-hoc reconstruction.
revision_closure.B05: Unknown is reachable only after all role, event, carrier, location, snapshot, causal and attempt predicates succeed and only the payload remains deliberately opaque.

closed_relations.roles_and_events: Both vocabularies are exhaustive; extra values are invalid rather than Unknown.
closed_relations.attempt_kind_and_R: Discovery and selected attempts are distinguished from the actual hook-attempt receipt count R; R is derived from H12A append receipts for the origin cell, not trusted from a projected DTO.
closed_relations.origin_proof: Per-run fresh challenge plus per-hook append chain plus immutable H16 raw snapshot, inspected before projection.
closed_relations.negative_status: A06 fixed identifiers and A07 post-hoc rechaining remain valid required negatives.

responsibility_split.checker: Validates exact pins and closed schemas, challenge uniqueness, identifier derivation, receipt formulas/order, carrier continuity, exact runtime Location/snapshots, attempt-kind/R relations, Unknown precedence, permutation invariants and raw-to-projected equality.
responsibility_split.candidate_verifier: Inspects the candidate source bindings and the live shared ledger before projection; proves each receipt originates at the pinned productive hook and rejects dead branches, cfg(test) decoys, projection-time synthesis, fixed IDs and reconstructed ledgers.

next_authority: An independent R2 oracle/adversary and preseal verifier must exercise the revised gate against future candidates before any implementation acceptance or seal.
